limitations: The CDPA upper bound is computer-assisted after a complete finite symmetry reduction and is specific to (n,q)=(7,8). The AONT result is linear only. Originality is to the best of our knowledge; the full texts of Yin's 2004 and 2005 difference-packing papers were not inspected and remain the principal residual coverage risk.
provenance: An exact extremal theorem for linear strong all-or-nothing transforms over F_9, proved by reducing the excluded size-seven case to a cyclic difference packing array and exactly resolving the resulting finite design parameter.
record_title: Exact q=9 linear strong AONT size via cyclic difference packing
